description:
Job Description: Bachelor's degree in Computer science or equivalent, with 8+ years of relevant experience.
 Minimum of 2 years of UI experience in HTML, HTML5, JavaScript, AngularJS, CSS, Node.js and other variants
 Very good application knowledge of JavaScript (including jQuery framework), HTML, CSS
 Concepts of Test and Learn (Hypothesis, KPIs, A/B vs. MVT Testing)
 Knowledge of node JS or Angular JS are desirable for future needs (new Advanced Web Frameworks in Nik's organization)
 UI skills set and need know the above tools/technologies for campaign targeting
 Demonstrate excellent communication skills including the ability to effective communicate with internal and external customers.
 Ability to use strong industry knowledge to relate to customer needs and dissolve customer concerns and high level of focus and attention to detail.
 Strong work ethic with good time management with ability to work with diverse teams and lead meetings.
 

 6+ Months Contract
